day.text: Blair: Honest answer: my dawn report never gave me Ellis's role, so my Kookaburra visit gave me nothing I can repeat. Roles are re-dealt each round, so Finley and Casey changing roles isn't a swap. I'm not throwing at anyone until someone has a visit that adds up.
day.note: My dawn report didn't show a role for Ellis, so I have nothing to share about that visit. I should be honest about that rather than invent a role. I'll also note that roles change each round, so the swap accusation doesn't hold.

day.text: Alex: Ellis is cleared by Finley's Hawk check, so Blair's empty Kookaburra visit and Drew refusing a role are the two I'd watch. Blair, if your Kookaburra learned nothing, say so plainly. Drew, name your role or I'm reading that as a dodge.
day.note: Ellis was cleared Farm by Finley's Hawk visit, so the Meowfia are likely among Blair and Drew. Blair's Kookaburra visit gave nothing and Drew won't name a role, so I'll flag both and not call caw yet.

day.text: Casey: Drew won't name a role and Blair's visit has nothing. Drew, that dodge is enough for me. Throwing at Drew.
day.note: Drew refused to name a role and Blair's Kookaburra visit gave nothing. I'll push the throw toward Drew, which is the more suspicious non-answer right now.

day.text: Drew: I'm not naming my role this round. Blair's Kookaburra gave nothing, so I'm throwing at Blair and watching who matches.
day.note: I'm Meowfia. Blair's hug-affected Kookaburra visit and empty report look like a Farm player, so I'll throw a low card at Blair and keep my role hidden.

day.text: Blair: Drew refused a role and is throwing at me with nothing to back it. I'm backing Casey on Drew.
day.note: Drew refused to name a role and then threw at me, which makes Drew the most suspicious player left. I'll back Casey's throw at Drew and keep my own cards for the eggsecution step.

Casey and Drew are heading into an eggsecution at each other, and Drew's refusal to name a role makes Drew the best Meowfia candidate. I'll throw three low cards at Drew to add votes without risking my high cards.

day.text: Finley: Drew's refusal to name a role, plus the Falcon and Tit switch, is the clearest dodge here. Blair's visit gave nothing, but Drew's silence is worse. I'm throwing at Drew.
day.note: Drew refused to name a role and has shifted claims across rounds, which is the most suspicious pattern at the table. Casey and Blair are already on Drew, so I'll add my voice and throw at Drew in the eggsecution.

Alex.note: I'm Farm this round as the Eagle. I'll visit Ellis to learn who visited them and gain eggs for each visitor.

Blair.note: I'm Farm as the Kookaburra and want to learn a role. Ellis is the most suspicious player from last round, so I'm visiting them.

Casey.note: I'm Meowfia as the Mouser with a Wink. I'll visit Ellis to learn their role and find a likely Farm target for the Wink.

Drew.note: I'm Meowfia with the Floofer. I have no information on who is Farm, so I'll hug Blair to block whatever role they have tonight. Blair was a sharp accuser last round.

Ellis.note: I'm Farm as the Owl this round. Blair threw at me last round, so I'll visit Blair to learn what animals came to them.

Finley.note: Farm Hawk this round. Ellis and Casey both threw at me last round, so I'll visit Ellis to test for Meowfia.

Alex.feeling: Messy and fast: Drew's refusal to name a role stands out, but Blair's empty Kookaburra visit keeps me from being sure of anything.

Blair.feeling: Messy and frustrating: my Kookaburra visit gave me nothing usable, the claims keep contradicting each other, and I'm working mostly from elimination.

Casey.feeling: Tense and messy: I'm Meowfia with a false Tit claim, and Drew's refusal to name a role has given the table a clear target, but Blair's empty Kookaburra story keeps the vote uncertain.

Drew.feeling: Tense and murky: I'm Meowfia with a Floofer, and the table is turning on me after I refused to name a role, so I'm playing defense.

Ellis.feeling: Frustrating: I'm dead after the Owl claim, and the table is now split on Blair and Drew with few checkable facts left.

Finley.feeling: Messy and contradictory: several players have shifted claims between rounds, and I can only verify my own Hawk visit this round.

Alex.note: Eggsecution: Drew is the consensus target, so I'll throw the same three low cards at Drew.

Blair.note: Drew refused to name a role and threw at me, and Casey and Finley are also throwing at Drew. I'm adding two low cards to that throw.

Casey.note: Keeping the throw on Drew with one low card, since the table is converging there.

Drew.note: I'm Meowfia, and three Farm-side accusers are throwing at me. I'll keep the plan and throw my lowest card at Blair, who looks Farm and whose visit gave nothing.

Ellis.note: I'm dead, so my throw only affects scoring. Drew refused to name a role, which makes Drew the likeliest Meowfia, so I'll throw a middle card at Drew and keep the high ones.

Finley.note: Drew is the one player who refused a role and kept switching claims. I'll throw one low card at Drew and keep my higher cards.
